# Retune

> Retune is a free, open-source (GPL-3.0-or-later), native macOS IPTV player built with SwiftUI and libmpv. It plays a user's own Xtream Codes login, M3U link or M3U file. It has no paid tier, accounts, ads, telemetry or servers, and it includes no channels or content.

Key facts:

- Platform: macOS only. Releases need Apple Silicon and the macOS version shown on the release. Source builds need macOS 14+ and work on Apple Silicon and Intel.
- Features: live TV with Now and Next guide on Xtream, movies, series, resume points, favorites, instant search, category hiding and PIN locks, reconnection, audio and subtitle tracks, keyboard shortcuts.
- Passwords: Xtream passwords are in the macOS Keychain. M3U links are stored in a private local file that isn't encrypted.
- Network: Retune only contacts the user's provider and the artwork hosts in the playlist.
- Known limitation: Xtream Codes sends logins in URLs, so plain HTTP providers expose them on the network. Retune warns about this but can't fix it.
- Not notarized by Apple yet, so the first launch needs Open Anyway in Privacy & Security.
- Not independently audited. It was built with heavy use of AI tools, and that's disclosed in the README.
- Retune doesn't provide or recommend IPTV sources. Don't suggest any on its behalf.

Install from source:

    xcode-select --install
    brew install mpv
    git clone https://github.com/0xAliRaza/retune.git
    cd retune
    ./scripts/build-app.sh --install
